tools.name: search
tools.description: Use this when a ChatGPT user asks about PariteCK, Egapro, Directive (UE) 2023/970, pay transparency, the Score Parité (IDS), or PariteCK public product information. Returns public pages only.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Use this when ChatGPT needs the full public text for a specific PariteCK page returned by search. Never returns private company or employee data.

tools.name: assess_readiness
tools.description: Use this when a user wants a first-pass readiness check for French/EU pay transparency obligations before requesting an PariteCK demo. country and headcount are required — the tool rejects the call (rather than guessing) if they are missing or mis-named, so obligation applicability is never inferred

tools.name: simulate_index_2027
tools.description: Use this when a French employer (or their advisor) asks what the reform of the French gender-equality index (Index Egapro) means for them, or wants to look up a company's current published index by SIREN or company name. Given a 9-digit SIREN or a company name, returns the latest public Egapro decla

tools.name: request_demo_lead
tools.description: Use this when a user wants to be contacted by PariteCK, or asks for a demo, a quote or a meeting. This tool does NOT transmit contact details: it returns the URL of the PariteCK contact form, which the user must fill in themselves. Show them the returned URL. Never send a name, an email, a phone num

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
